## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester meaning: make a complex randomized photographic concept that visibly exercises the current topic, resolved in the conversation as electricity, lightning, electrical discharge and electrical apparatus; use the attached photograph. Reference scope is facial appearance and hairstyle, rather than inferred biography or personality. Authorial direction: the reference woman qualifies a restored travelling museum demonstrator after university hours. A brief electrostatic spark across two metal spheres contrasts with continuous orange-red glow inside a separate neon tube. The open case, replaced collar and pencilled log connect repair to successful use, while her lifted gaze and small relieved smile connect apparatus to response. I selected this successful-test realization over a failure scene because it makes both electrical carriers observable and gives the moment a readable next possibility. WHO: an attentive operator finishing a repair qualification; WHERE: an inhabited demonstration room that supports the apparatus; HOW: an observational environmental portrait at an intimate working distance; WHY NOW: a newly restored rig finally responds. Saved sensual=1 supports quiet attraction through her particular face, warm cheek light and relaxed bearing; fetish=0 and surreal=0 add no treatment. Creativity=1 shapes restrained variations within the random concept. All subtype, location, role, clothing, pose, affect, camera and repair narrative choices are agent-owned.
subject: A woman whose facial appearance and hairstyle use the supplied image reference
setting: An after-hours university electrical demonstration room with a restored portable teaching rig and an open travelling case
event: Visible electrical discharges while the woman observes a live test
visual_priorities: A small blue-white spark visibly bridges two metal electrode surfaces in air, while a continuous orange-red glow remains inside the separate curved glass tube.
The reference face and short bob remain readable beside the apparatus, with her lifted gaze and restrained relieved response connecting the electrical test to her attention.
The pencil and open logbook, removed collar, newly fitted collar and ready travelling case make repair and imminent use legible within the frame.
A left-to-right arrangement and localized practical light separate the spark, gas glow and human presence without drowning the electrical carriers in decoration.
baseline_prompt_en: An observational environmental portrait shows electricity visibly at work through visible electrical discharges. The woman follows the supplied reference for her facial appearance and hairstyle, retaining its slender oval face, large almond-shaped gray-brown eyes, natural brows, softly full lips, and short dark brown bob with fine wispy bangs. She is qualifying a restored portable teaching rig in an after-hours university demonstration room. The photograph catches the first test that has worked well enough for her to lift her attention from the logbook to the apparatus. On the left side of the bench, an electrostatic generator with two vertical glass disks feeds two polished spherical electrodes set several centimeters apart. A thin, intensely bright blue-white zigzag spark bridges their open air gap; the two ends of this brief channel visibly meet the facing metal surfaces. To its right, a separately powered curved neon discharge tube stands upright on small ceramic mounts. Continuous orange-red gas glow fills the narrow bore inside its clear glass wall, with its luminous shape exactly following the tube's curve. Black insulated leads meet the tube's two electrode caps and run back to its compact supply. The spark and the glowing tube are separated in space and clearly differ in color, carrier, and shape. A transparent apparatus cover sits between these devices and the operator's console, its edges and reflections staying subordinate to the electrical phenomena. The woman stands on the console side in a soft ivory sleeveless knit top and charcoal utility trousers. Her left hand rests on the near edge of the console; her right hand holds a pencil just above an open logbook. Her gaze has just lifted toward the spark, and concentration is giving way to a small relieved half-smile. The tilt of her head exposes the familiar face rather than presenting a stock technician pose. In the lower foreground, an open travelling case cradles a removed blackened tube collar and a clean spare tube, while the newly fitted collar remains visible on the glowing apparatus. Pencil traces in the log, the discarded collar, and the ready case connect this living moment to the repair and to the demonstrator's next journey. Make a landscape 3:2 photograph with a natural 35 mm perspective, viewed from chest height at a gentle three-quarter angle. Arrange the apparatus to the left, her face to the right, and the hands and logbook lower between them. Keep the face, spark endpoints, and curved glass wall sufficiently resolved to read together. A warm task lamp gives her cheek and the knit a quiet tactile presence; the small blue-white spark and the orange-red tube emit their own localized light. Preserve natural skin texture, clear glass reflections, dark metal detail, and the difference between a brief air discharge and a sustained glow inside glass.
